interface.shortDescription: Org charts from lists or CSV
interface.longDescription: Org chart maker: turn a team list, spreadsheet or CSV into an editable organizational chart in seconds. Show reporting lines, departments, open roles and FTE, start from org chart templates (startup, corporate, school, nonprofit), then edit, export and share it in your browser. No account needed to open a chart link.
